column1: # SHEtoken India Widow Vulnerability by State — 2025

column9: Highest widow poverty. Child widows from early marriage. Gaya temples. JEEViKA helps some.
Deoghar (Baba Dham) temple town. Tribal widow land rights particularly vulnerable.
Vrindavan (15-20K abandoned widows), Varanasi, Mathura. Hindi belt worst for widow abandonment.
Ujjain, Chitrakoot temple towns. High poverty.
Sati tradition history. Pushkar temple town. Widow remarriage highly stigmatised.
Puri (Jagannath) — widows come to die here. Significant temple town population.
Kamakhya temple. High widow poverty in tea garden communities.
Vrindavan: many Bengali widows. Kalighat, Tarapith temples. Kanyashree helps girls avoid early widowhood.
Tirupati abandoned widows documented. Srisailam. Telugu widow property cases.
Dharmasthala, Udupi pilgrim towns. Moderate protection.
Urban widows better protected. Pandharpur temple. Pandharpur widows documented.
Dwarka, Somnath temple towns. SEWA includes widows in programs.
Better state support. Tiruvannamalai some concentration. Stronger property laws.
Best widow protection in India. Kudumbashree includes widows. Strong property rights.
